# Unwrapped

> Unwrapped (https://myunwrapped.com) is a privacy-first web app that reads the official data export of Instagram, TikTok, X (Twitter), Facebook, Threads and LinkedIn inside the user's browser. It shows who doesn't follow you back, who unfollowed you (by comparing two exports), mutual followers, fake/bot followers, real TikTok screen time, DM statistics, search history and what advertisers know about you. It never asks for a password, never logs in to any account and uploads nothing: the ZIP file is processed on the device.

Key facts:
- How it works: request your data from the platform (Instagram: Accounts Center → Your information and permissions → Download your information → Followers and following, JSON), then drop the ZIP on myunwrapped.com.
- Safe by design: no login, no password, no browser extension, no automation on the account — so it cannot get an account banned or blocked.
- Who unfollowed you: needs two exports from different dates; every export is kept as a private snapshot in the browser and compared automatically.
- Free: the analysis, counts, not-following-back list preview, TikTok screen time and demo are free.
- Paid plans (one-time crypto payments, no auto-renewal, no account): Plus $5/month or $29/year; Pro $9/month, $49/year or $99 lifetime; Creator $19/month or $119/year.
- Languages: English, Spanish, Portuguese (Brazil), Turkish, French, German.

## Tools
- [Instagram unfollowers & not following back](https://myunwrapped.com/instagram/): who doesn't follow you back, who unfollowed you, follow requests, mutuals, fans.
- [Instagram follower tracker](https://myunwrapped.com/instagram-follower-tracker/): followers gained and lost over time from repeated exports.
- [Export Instagram followers to CSV/Excel](https://myunwrapped.com/export-instagram-followers/)
- [Fake follower checker](https://myunwrapped.com/fake-follower-checker/): bot and spam followers with an audience quality grade.
- [Threads unfollowers](https://myunwrapped.com/threads-unfollowers/)
- [TikTok screen time, watch history & unfollowers](https://myunwrapped.com/tiktok/)
- [X (Twitter) archive viewer & unfollowers](https://myunwrapped.com/x/)
- [Instagram DM analyzer](https://myunwrapped.com/instagram-dm-analyzer/) and [message viewer](https://myunwrapped.com/instagram-message-viewer/)
- [Unwrapped Bio — free link in bio page](https://myunwrapped.com/bio/): a fast page at myunwrapped.com/@name with links, socials, photo, a featured Telegram/WhatsApp button and click analytics. Free up to 5 links; Pro (up to 100 links, unlimited contacts, visitor insights, brand colours, scheduled links, no badge) is included in every Unwrapped plan. A free Linktree alternative.
- [All tools](https://myunwrapped.com/tools/) · [Pricing](https://myunwrapped.com/pricing/)
